title: The Lady from the Sea
blurb: Written between Hedda Gabler and The Master Builder. Ellida Wangel is caught between a stormy past and the security of family and responsibility with her husband, Dr. Wangel. In a home on a fjord, the sea is a constant presence. Will she remain and suffocate — or find freedom across the water?
